privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: This policy explains what data Puzzled collects, why it is collected, and how to contact us about it.

cta.title: Other pages you may need
cta.body: The Terms of Service cover accounts, subscriptions, and conduct. Support helps with account and billing questions.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: This policy explains how Sylphx Limited ("we", "us", or "our") collects and uses personal data when you use Puzzled, and the rights you have over it.

controller.title: Who is responsible for your data
controller.content: Sylphx Limited (registered in England and Wales, company number 16438428; registered office: 128 City Road, London EC1V 2NX, United Kingdom) is the controller of your personal data under the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.

dataCollection.title: Data We Collect
dataCollection.content: We collect the following types of information:

items.account: Account information: name, email address, and profile picture
items.game: Game data: scores, statistics, streaks, and game history
items.payment: Payment information: Stripe collects your card details; we receive your subscription status, amounts, dates and Stripe references
items.technical: Technical data: IP address, browser type, and device information
items.errors: Error reports: when a page or our server fails, we record the error message, stack trace and page path (never the query string, email addresses or anything you typed) in Sylphx Observability, our own error-monitoring service, to find and fix the fault
items.referral: Referral tags: if you arrive through a link that carries campaign tags (utm_ parameters or a referral id, for example from another Sylphx product), and you have accepted analytics cookies, we keep those tags for 30 days in a first-party cookie and store them with your account and subscription if you sign up or subscribe. We use them to know which link brought you, and we do not sell them.

dataUse.title: How we use your data, and our legal basis
dataUse.content: We use your data for these purposes, on these legal bases under the UK GDPR:

items.service: To provide Puzzled, your account, Puzzled Plus and the family plan, and to answer your requests: performance of our contract with you
items.improve: To keep Puzzled secure, prevent cheating, abuse and fraud, fix faults, and understand and improve our games: our legitimate interests in running a safe, working and improving service
items.communicate: To send you messages about your account, subscription and changes to Puzzled: our contract with you and our legitimate interests
items.analytics: To measure how Puzzled is played and which links bring players, using analytics and the referral cookie: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time in Settings
items.legal: To keep tax and accounting records, respond to lawful requests, and establish, exercise or defend legal claims: our legal obligations and our legitimate interests
items.noSale: We do not sell your personal data. Players without Puzzled Plus may see advertising on the archive and result screens (never during a puzzle), served by Google AdSense; the ad is shown, and advertising cookies are set, only if you accepted cookies.

payments.title: Payments
payments.content: When you subscribe, Stripe processes your payment; we never receive your full card number. We keep a record of your subscription, payments and refunds (amounts, dates and Stripe references) for as long as tax and accounting law requires. If you delete your account, these records are kept without your player ID.

thirdParty.title: Who we share data with
thirdParty.content: We share personal data with service providers that process it for us under contract, including:
thirdParty.others: We may also share data with our hosting providers, professional advisers, authorities where the law requires it, and a buyer or successor if our business or Puzzled is sold or reorganized.

transfers.title: International transfers
transfers.content: Some of our providers process data outside the UK. Where they do, we rely on UK adequacy regulations or on safeguards the law approves, such as the UK International Data Transfer Agreement or the UK Addendum to the EU standard contractual clauses. Contact us for a copy of the relevant safeguard.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.content: We keep your account and game data while your account is open. When you delete your account, we erase your game history, stats, streaks, profile and settings. We keep other data only for as long as we need it for the purposes above, including to meet legal obligations, prevent fraud and abuse, and establish or defend legal claims. Backups and logs are overwritten in the normal course of operation.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies that are strictly necessary to sign you in, keep Puzzled secure and remember your settings. We use analytics and the referral cookie only if you accept them, and you can change your choice at any time in Settings.

rights.title: Your Rights

items.restrict: Ask us to restrict how we use your data
items.object: Object at any time to our use of your data based on our legitimate interests, and to any direct marketing
items.withdraw: Withdraw your consent at any time, where we rely on it, without affecting use before you withdrew
items.complain: Complain to us, and to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk) if you are unhappy with how we handle your data

rights.response: We answer requests within one month, which the law allows us to extend by up to two further months for complex or numerous requests. We make reasonable and proportionate searches, and we may charge a reasonable fee for, or refuse, a request that is manifestly unfounded or excessive.

children.title: Children
children.content: Puzzled accounts are for people aged 13 and over. If we learn that we hold an account of a child under 13, we may close it and delete its data. We do not profile children for marketing.

security.title: Security and breaches
security.content: We protect personal data with appropriate technical and organizational measures, but no service is completely secure. If a personal data breach occurs, we notify the Information Commissioner's Office where the law requires, and we tell you directly where the breach is likely to result in a high risk to your rights and freedoms.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.content: We may update this policy. We post the new version on this page with a new date. If we plan to use your personal data for a new purpose, we tell you before we do.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: For privacy-related inquiries, contact us at:

terms.lead: These terms set out the rules that apply when you use Puzzled, including accounts, Puzzled Plus subscriptions and conduct.

keyTerms.title: Key terms
keyTerms.content: Please read these points in particular. The full terms below explain each one.

items.renewal: Puzzled Plus renews automatically until you cancel. You can cancel at any time in Settings > Subscription.
items.refunds: Cancel your first subscription within 14 days for a full refund. After that, payments are not refunded, except where the law requires.
items.changes: We may change games, features, prices and these terms. If a change materially reduces what you have paid for, you can cancel.
items.suspension: We may suspend or close accounts that cheat or break these terms.
items.liability: Our liability to you is limited, as Limitation of Liability explains. Your statutory rights as a consumer are not affected.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing or using Puzzled, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, do not use our services. If a translation of these terms differs from the English version, the English version applies.

seller.title: Who we are
seller.content: Puzzled is provided by Sylphx Limited, a company registered in England and Wales (company number 16438428). Registered office: 128 City Road, London EC1V 2NX, United Kingdom. VAT number: GB 502 7862 95.

service.title: Our Service
service.content: Puzzled provides daily puzzle games and challenges for personal, non-commercial use. We may change, add or remove games, features, content and limits, and suspend or withdraw Puzzled or any part of it, for example for maintenance, security, legal or business reasons. If a change materially reduces what a paid subscription gives you, we tell you in advance, and you may cancel and receive a refund for the time left in the period you have paid for.

accounts.title: User Accounts
accounts.content: You must be 13 or over to create an account, and if you are under 18 you need a parent or guardian's permission to subscribe. When creating an account, you agree to:

items.responsible: Be responsible for all activity under your account

subscriptions.title: Puzzled Plus subscriptions
subscriptions.content: Today's featured puzzle is free. Puzzled Plus is an optional paid subscription that opens every game, the archive of past days, and stats for every game.

items.billing: Prices are shown before you pay and include VAT where it applies. Stripe takes payment when you subscribe and at the start of each monthly or yearly period.
items.renewal: Your subscription renews automatically until you cancel. You can cancel at any time in Settings > Subscription; you keep access until the end of the period you have paid for and are not charged again.
items.cancellation: Cancellation right: you may cancel your first subscription within 14 days of starting it and get a full refund, however much you have played. Cancel in Settings > Subscription or email us.
items.refund: After those 14 days, payments are non-refundable and we do not refund part-used periods, except where these terms or the law say otherwise.
items.price: We may change the price of Puzzled Plus. We tell you in advance, before a new price applies to your next renewal, and you can cancel before then.
items.family: A family plan covers the subscriber and up to three people they invite. The subscriber can remove people at any time.
items.statutory: Nothing in these terms affects your statutory rights as a consumer.

items.legal: Use the service only for lawful purposes
items.respect: Respect other users and our community
items.noCheat: Not use cheats, exploits, or automated tools
items.noInterfere: Not copy, scrape, reverse engineer or interfere with Puzzled, except where the law allows

suspension.title: Suspension and closing accounts
suspension.content: We may suspend or close your account, and remove or reset scores, streaks or leaderboard entries, if we reasonably believe you have broken these terms (including by cheating), for security reasons, or where the law requires. Otherwise we give you reasonable notice before we close an account. If we close your account without a serious reason while a paid period is left, we refund the unused part.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.content: All games, content, and materials on Puzzled are our property or licensed to us. You may not copy, modify, or distribute any content without permission. You give us a worldwide, royalty-free license to use your display name, profile picture and results to run Puzzled, including leaderboards and shared results, and a perpetual, irrevocable license to use any feedback you send us.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: Puzzled is provided for entertainment. We supply it with reasonable care and skill and as described, as the law requires, but we do not promise that it will be uninterrupted or error-free, or that scores, streaks or statistics will never be lost or corrected.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: We are responsible for loss you suffer that is a foreseeable result of our breaking these terms or failing to use reasonable care and skill. We are not responsible for loss that was not foreseeable, for loss caused by events outside our reasonable control, or for any business loss, such as lost profit or opportunity, because Puzzled is for personal use. If digital content we supply damages your device or other digital content because we did not use reasonable care and skill, we will repair the damage or pay you compensation. Otherwise, our total liability to you is limited to the greater of what you paid us in the 12 months before the claim arose and £100. Nothing in these terms limits our liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for fraud, or for anything else the law does not allow us to limit.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We may change these terms, for example to reflect changes to Puzzled, the law or our business. We post the new terms on this page with a new date. If a change materially affects you, we tell you in advance, and if you have a paid subscription you can cancel before the change applies and receive a refund for the unused part of your period. Otherwise, the new terms apply once posted.

general.title: General
general.content: We may transfer our rights and obligations under these terms to another organization, for example if Puzzled is sold; we will tell you, and you can cancel if you are unhappy. You may not transfer yours. If a court finds part of these terms unenforceable, the rest stays in force. If we do not enforce a term straight away, we can still enforce it later. These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales. You can bring a claim in the courts of England and Wales, or in your local courts if you live in Scotland, Northern Ireland or another country, and you keep the protection of the mandatory consumer law of the place you live.
